en.headline: Tung Wah social enterprises open free exhibition on dignified dining at iBakery Gallery Café
en.dek: The display at Tamar Park runs until 31 March and pairs portraits of public figures with stories about adapting meals for those with chewing difficulties.
body: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals’ social enterprises CookEasy and iBakery have opened an exhibition titled “Everyone Can Eat Well 2026” at the iBakery Gallery Café in Tamar Park, Admiralty.

The free display, which continues until 31 March next year, presents the dietary stories of ten people from different fields, including public figures and care-home residents, alongside visual works that combine past photographs, contemporary portraits and age-progressed images.

Organisers said the show aims to raise awareness of “care food” — meals that remain nutritious and appealing for people with reduced chewing ability — and to show that dignified dining does not depend on age or physical condition.
The café is open during normal operating hours. Visitors can view the exhibition without prior booking.

zh.headline: 東華三院社企於添馬公園iBakery舉辦「人人都可以食得好」展覽
zh.dek: 展覽即日起至明年3月31日於金鐘添馬公園添馬茶座舉行，以圖文及影像呈現不同人士的飲食故事，關注咀嚼能力減弱者的尊嚴飲食。
body: 東華三院旗下社企CookEasy（煮餥易）及iBakery（愛烘焙餐廳）於金鐘添馬公園添馬茶座的iBakery Gallery Café舉辦「人人都可以食得好 2026」主題展覽。
免費展覽展期至明年3月31日，展出十位來自不同範疇人士的飲食故事，包括公眾人物及安老院院友，並配以結合舊照、人像畫及模擬年長樣貌的視覺作品。
主辦方表示，展覽希望提升公眾對「照護食」的認識，即為咀嚼能力減弱人士設計既營養又賣相精緻的餐膳，並強調人人都應享有尊嚴地享受美食的權利。
茶座於正常營業時間開放，市民可直接前往參觀，毋須預約。
